description: S(4) exact metallic LP active-set sweep on the canonical T_w basis of H_4(q) (24 positive reduced words), plus the exact-Gram n=3 re-run closing the prior probe's rank-1 Gram approximation.  Exact costs t_i = tr_M(b_i) and Gram G_ij = tr_M(b_i b_j) from native Hoefsmit characters (pyhecke_native), two weight conventions: plancherel (y_λ = H_q(λ)²/[n]_q!, the proved-S(2) convention) and canonical Markov (trace_weights_n).  LP duals emitted per the LP/SDP discipline; cost-coincidence loci located and classified against the metallic ladder δ_1..δ_4.
limitations: LP solved in f64 (scipy highs); coincidence roots refined by f64 bisection and—where a root lands within 1e-6 of a metallic ratio in the plancherel convention—re-verified at 40-dps mpfr (residual_at_metallic field).

Basis is the canonical positive T_w lift; the prior n=3 probe's NF basis used one inverse word (L_- = σ₀⁻¹σ₁⁻¹), replaced here by σ₂σ₁.  Active-set indices are therefore not 1:1 comparable to the 2026-06-09 approximate n=3 probe on that one element.
n_target=1.0 and the Frobenius-cone constraint Gx ≥ 0 follow the prior probes; physical demand vectors (per-nucleus) are out of scope for this structural probe.
